:::{#exr-gram-matrix-practice}
#### Computing a Gram matrix

The [Gram matrix](#def-gram-matrix) holds the [dot products](linear-algebra-vectors.qmd#def-dot-product)
of every pair of [columns](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-matrix-column) of a matrix $\matr{A}$.
Let

$$
\matr{A} = \sbmat{1 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 \\ 1 & 0}.
$$

Compute $\tp{\matr{A}}\matr{A}$.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Entry $(i, j)$ is $\vecf{a}_i \cdot \vecf{a}_j$,
so entries $(1, 2)$ and $(2, 1)$ agree.

:::

:::
